description.narrative: The Responsible Commodities Facility (or hereafter “RCF”) is an Brazilian / UK multi-party financial vehicle managed by SIM Investment Management that provides revolving working capital loans with discounted interest rates to soybean farmers with an initial commitment to renew for 4 years. Loans are offered to farmers that meet eligibility criteria for protection of native vegetation (including >5% of excess legal reserve) with the intention to promote the production / trading of deforestation-free soy from the Cerrado region of Brazil. The facility is overseen by an Environmental Committee with the participation of different stakeholders including UNEP, WWF, amongst others.
